answer_3.quote: ...we prompt the LLM to weight all class predictions based on their associated explanations in an in-context manner... we develop an explanation scorer based on the LLM M, directly harnessing its inherent reasoning capabilities...

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct additional human studies to further investigate whether the scores generated by LLM are aligned with human preferences...we ask human raters to indicate the 'faithfulness' and 'consistency' of the explanations...
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate each explanation for faithfulness (groundedness in input) and consistency (entailment of the prediction).
